requirements.title: Local variables are accessible only in their scoping unit and contained scopes
requirements.definition: A local variable of a module, submodule, main program, subprogram, or BLOCK construct is accessible only in that scoping unit or construct and in contained scoping units and constructs.

pending.contained-scope-access: Declare a host subprogram local integer x initialized to 37 and an internal subroutine with no local x that copies x to y initialized to -11; call it and assert y=37, with a mutation adding an internal local x=-5 to make wrong resolution observable.
pending.block-local-does-not-escape: Use an outer integer x=-9, inside BLOCK declare local integer x=44 and assign x=45, then after END BLOCK assert outer x remains -9; mutation removes the BLOCK declaration so the assignment changes the outer sentinel.
